title: Cultural Divergence Preservation: Diagnosing Flattening and Caricature in LLM-Simulated Survey Populations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Cultural Divergence Preservation (CDP) by computing the Jensen-Shannon divergence between country-specific LLM survey response distributions and a cross-country centroid, and comparing it against human reference data to identify either cultural flattening (attenuated divergence) or cultural caricature (exaggerated divergence).
